children: The annual inflation rate in the Philippines accelerated to 7.8% in October 2026 from 7.2% in September, exceeding expectations of 7.6% and marking the highest reading since February 2023.

Transport inflation surged to 20.1% from 14.6%, while inflation for housing, water, electricity, gas and other fuels increased to 9.3% from 8.4%, as the prolonged Middle East conflict drove up costs in a country heavily reliant on energy supplies from the region.
Price growth also accelerated for restaurants and accommodation services (7.7% vs 7%), health (5.9% vs 5.6%), and furnishings and household equipment (5% vs 4.7%).
In contrast, food and non-alcoholic beverage inflation eased to 6.1% from 6.7%.
On a monthly basis, consumer prices rose 0.7%, following a 1% increase in September.
Core inflation also accelerated to 5.4%, its highest level since September 2023, from an upwardly revised 4.8% in September, exceeding market expectations of 4.8%.

title: Philippines Inflation Rate Surges to 7.8%
